subsystems.name: Power system
subsystems.role: supplies the large electrical pulse needed to accelerate the carrier.

subsystems.name: Launch track
subsystems.role: supports and guides the carrier along a straight path.
parts: thermal control to handle lunar day–night swings

subsystems.name: Accelerator
subsystems.role: drives the carrier up to launch speed.
parts: control electronics for timing and current

subsystems.name: Carrier and payload
subsystems.role: holds the material during acceleration and releases it in orbit.

subsystems.name: Orbital receiving system
subsystems.role: catches the launched payloads and moves them to where they are needed.

subsystems.name: Surface mining and loading
subsystems.role: digs, processes and feeds regolith or refined material to the launcher.

buildSteps.title: Choose a site
buildSteps.detail: Pick a flat, stable area near the equator with a clear launch corridor and accessible regolith, away from heritage sites.

buildSteps.title: Land power and base equipment
buildSteps.detail: Deliver a fission reactor or large solar farm with energy storage, plus habitats and construction machinery.

buildSteps.title: Prepare the ground
buildSteps.detail: Level and compact the regolith, then build foundations that will not shift under repeated launches.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the track
buildSteps.detail: Lay and align segmented rails over several kilometres, using the Moon’s low gravity to allow a lighter structure than on Earth.

buildSteps.title: Install accelerator coils
buildSteps.detail: Place linear motor coils along the track, wire them to the power system and connect the control network.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate carriers
buildSteps.detail: Build lightweight carriers that can survive high acceleration and hold containers of regolith.

buildSteps.title: Test and calibrate
buildSteps.detail: Launch increasing masses at progressively higher speeds, tuning the acceleration profile and release timing.

buildSteps.title: Integrate mining and loading
buildSteps.detail: Automate digging, crushing and loading so the launcher can fire repeatedly without human intervention.

buildSteps.title: Deploy the orbital tug
buildSteps.detail: Position a spacecraft in lunar orbit to rendezvous with each payload, capture it and carry it to a construction site.

prerequisites.tech: Heavy lunar landing and surface operations
prerequisites.why: robotic landers have reached the Moon, but landing hundreds of tonnes of equipment and building a base is not yet routine.

prerequisites.tech: In-situ resource utilisation (mining and processing regolith)
prerequisites.why: mining and processing have been demonstrated in labs and small field tests, but not at production scale on the Moon.

prerequisites.tech: Space fission reactors or very large solar arrays
prerequisites.why: compact fission reactors are being developed for space, and solar farms would need to be assembled over a large area.

prerequisites.tech: High-power linear motors and pulsed power
prerequisites.why: the basic technology is used in trains and launchers on Earth, but must be adapted for vacuum, dust and temperature extremes.

prerequisites.tech: Orbital rendezvous and capture of high-speed payloads
prerequisites.why: no spacecraft has yet caught a payload moving at kilometres per second in lunar orbit.
building a kilometres-long, millimetre-aligned track in vacuum and wild temperature swings has never been attempted.

pathway.milestone: robotic prospecting and small mining demonstrations on the lunar surface
pathway.unlocks: knowledge of regolith properties and the basics of digging and processing.

pathway.milestone: a small demonstrator launcher that throws a few kilograms into lunar orbit
pathway.unlocks: proof that electromagnetic launch works in the lunar environment.

pathway.milestone: a full-scale mass driver powered by a surface reactor, launching hundreds of tonnes per year
pathway.unlocks: a steady supply of bulk material in lunar orbit at far lower cost than Earth launch.

pathway.milestone: orbital construction of large structures such as solar power satellites or habitats using lunar material
pathway.unlocks: space infrastructure at a scale that Earth-launched rockets cannot economically support.
